mergedParams.userDescription: Digital data mosh static glitch screen tear transition effects between videos

output.title: Digital Glitch Static Data Mosh Screen Tear Transitions

prompts.prompt: Create a digital data mosh glitch transition preset that simulates corrupted video data during the transition period. The transition should feature heavy pixelation and RGB channel separation effects. Use a BaseLayout container with two VideoAtom elements where the outgoing video gradually corrupts with increasing glitch intensity while the incoming video emerges from the digital chaos. During the 1-second overlap period, apply alternating opacity flickers (0.1s intervals) to both videos to simulate data corruption, combined with horizontal displacement transforms that shift the videos left/right by random amounts (translateX between -20px to 20px). Add a custom CSS filter that applies contrast(200%) and saturate(0%) periodically to create the data mosh effect. The outgoing video should have increasing blur and decreasing opacity while the incoming video starts with heavy blur that clears up. Use z-index layering where the incoming video sits above but uses 'mix-blend-mode: screen' during the transition for a digital overlay effect.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with duration calculation: video1.duration + video2.duration - 1s overlap. VideoAtom positioning with 'absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover'. Outgoing video effects: opacity AnimationRange from 1 to 0 over last 1s, blur filter from 0px to 8px, transform with random translateX values every 0.1s. Incoming video: starts at video1.duration - 1s, opacity from 0 to 1, blur from 8px to 0px. Add shake effect using transform rotateZ alternating between -2deg and 2deg. Use provider mode effects with targetIds for each video. Apply 'glitch-text' animation keyframes to container for RGB split effect.

prompts.prompt: Design a screen tear transition that simulates a CRT monitor malfunction between videos. The transition should create horizontal scan lines that tear across the screen, revealing the next video underneath. Implement this using a BaseLayout with multiple thin horizontal div overlays (10-15 divs) positioned absolutely across the height, each with varying animation delays. The outgoing VideoAtom should have sections that appear to 'stick' and lag behind while other sections tear away faster. During the 0.8s overlap, apply a sawtooth wave pattern to the opacity of scan line divs (opacity oscillating between 0 and 1). The incoming video should have a static noise texture overlay that fades out as it becomes fully visible. Add chromatic aberration by slightly offsetting red and blue channels using CSS filters on alternating scan lines.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container with 'relative overflow-hidden'. Create scan line divs with 'absolute w-full h-[10%]' positioned at different top percentages. Outgoing VideoAtom with segmented opacity animations (different timing for each horizontal section). Incoming VideoAtom starts at video1.duration - 0.8s. Apply transform: skewX() to scan lines with values between -5deg to 5deg. Use CSS animation for scan line flicker: @keyframes scan { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0; } 50% { opacity: 1; } }. Add filter: hue-rotate() with rapid changes during transition. Static overlay using pseudo-element with noise texture background.

prompts.prompt: Build a VHS tracking error transition that simulates analog video distortion when switching between clips. The transition should feature horizontal bands that shift and distort, with color bleeding and temporal displacement. Use a BaseLayout containing two VideoAtoms where the outgoing video develops increasing horizontal displacement bands (like VHS tracking errors) while the incoming video stabilizes from similar distortion. During the 1.2s overlap, create 5-7 horizontal bands using absolute positioned divs that shift left/right with different timing functions. Apply a rainbow color shift effect using hue-rotate filters that cycle through 360 degrees. Add temporal displacement by having different bands show content from slightly different timestamps (simulate using opacity and blur combinations).
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative bg-black overflow-hidden'. VideoAtoms with 'absolute inset-0'. Create tracking bands using divs with 'absolute w-full h-[15%]' at different vertical positions. Outgoing video: apply translateX animations to bands, ranging from -30px to 30px with ease-in-out timing. Incoming video starts at video1.duration - 1.2s with inverse band animations. Use filter effects: hue-rotate(0deg to 360deg), contrast(150%), brightness(110%). Add subtle vertical hold issue with translateY oscillation between -5px and 5px. Implement color bleed with box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255,0,255,0.5).

prompts.prompt: Create a matrix digital rain transition where the outgoing video dissolves into cascading green code characters before reforming as the incoming video. The effect should simulate the iconic digital rain effect with characters falling at different speeds. Implement using a BaseLayout with a grid overlay of small divs (20x30 grid) containing random characters. During the 1.5s transition, the outgoing VideoAtom's visibility is progressively masked by the falling characters (using opacity masks), while the incoming video is revealed in the opposite pattern. Characters should have varying animation delays and durations to create an organic falling effect. Add a green tint filter and scanline effect for authenticity.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative bg-black overflow-hidden'. Create grid using CSS grid: 'grid grid-cols-20 grid-rows-30 gap-0'. Each cell div with 'text-green-400 text-xs font-mono'. Outgoing VideoAtom with decreasing opacity masked by grid cells. Incoming VideoAtom starts at video1.duration - 1.5s. Animation: each grid cell has translateY from -100% to 100vh with random duration between 0.5s-2s and random delay 0-1s. Apply filter: sepia(100%) hue-rotate(90deg) saturate(200%) to achieve matrix green. Add ::before pseudo-element for scanlines with linear-gradient. Use mix-blend-mode: screen on character grid.

prompts.prompt: Design a corrupted file glitch transition that simulates a damaged video file switching to another. The transition should feature blocky artifacts, frozen frames, and digital noise bursts. Use a BaseLayout with mosaic-style div blocks (8x8 grid) that randomly freeze, shift, and corrupt during the transition. The outgoing VideoAtom should progressively break down into frozen pixel blocks that flicker and shift position, while the incoming video assembles from similar corrupted blocks. During the 0.7s overlap, implement random block freezing (opacity: 0 on random blocks) and position shifts (transform: translate with random values). Add RGB channel splitting on corrupted blocks.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative overflow-hidden bg-gray-900'. Create 8x8 grid of divs using 'grid grid-cols-8 grid-rows-8'. Each block with 'absolute w-[12.5%] h-[12.5%]'. Outgoing video with staggered opacity reduction per block. Incoming video starts at video1.duration - 0.7s. Block corruption: random translateX/Y between -10px to 10px, random rotation between -5deg to 5deg. Apply filter per block: contrast(200%) brightness(random 50%-150%). Use animation-delay with random values 0-0.5s per block. Add box-shadow for RGB split: 2px 0 red, -2px 0 cyan.

prompts.prompt: Build a static interference transition that simulates signal loss between broadcast videos. The effect should create waves of static that wash across the screen in patterns. Implement using a BaseLayout with animated noise texture overlays and signal interference patterns. The outgoing VideoAtom should experience increasing static interference (alternating visibility with static noise), while the incoming video emerges through decreasing static. During the 1s overlap, create pulsing static waves using multiple absolutely positioned divs with animated gradients. Add horizontal roll effect where the image appears to slip vertically. Include audio visualization bars that spike during maximum interference.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative bg-black overflow-hidden'. Static overlay divs with 'absolute inset-0' using CSS gradient: repeating-linear-gradient with black/white stops. Outgoing video opacity alternates between 1 and 0.3 rapidly (0.05s intervals). Incoming video starts at video1.duration - 1s with inverse pattern. Horizontal roll: translateY animation oscillating between -20px and 20px. Static waves: use radial-gradient moving from center outward. Audio bars: 5 divs with 'absolute bottom-0 w-[10%] bg-white' with random height animations. Add filter: contrast(300%) brightness(150%) during peak static.

prompts.prompt: Create a cyberpunk hologram glitch transition where videos switch through a futuristic holographic interference pattern. The transition should feature scan lines, holographic flicker, and chromatic aberration. Use a BaseLayout with layered holographic effects including horizontal scan lines that move vertically and glitch out during transition. The outgoing VideoAtom should develop holographic instability with blue/cyan tinting and transparency issues, while incoming video materializes through the holographic interference. During 1.3s overlap, implement flickering opacity (0.8 to 0.2) with RGB channel offsets that increase then decrease.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative bg-gray-950 overflow-hidden'. Scan lines using ::after with background: repeating-linear-gradient transparent 0px, rgba(0,255,255,0.1) 2px. Outgoing video with opacity keyframes: 1, 0.8, 0.3, 0.8, 0. Incoming video starts at video1.duration - 1.3s. Chromatic aberration: use three overlapping divs with red, green, blue filters and slight position offsets (1-3px). Holographic flicker: opacity animation with steps(2) for sharp on/off effect. Add transform: perspective(1000px) rotateY oscillating between -2deg and 2deg. Blue glow: box-shadow: 0 0 30px cyan.

prompts.prompt: Design a broken transmission transition that simulates a deteriorating satellite signal between videos. The effect should show progressive signal degradation with macro blocking, color banding, and frame drops. Implement using BaseLayout with a pixelated grid system where blocks of pixels freeze, shift color, and drop out. The outgoing VideoAtom experiences increasing compression artifacts (created using scaled-up low-res overlays), while incoming video resolves from heavy pixelation. During 0.9s overlap, create macro blocks that freeze at different times, shift hue randomly, and have varying opacity. Add interlacing effect with alternating horizontal lines.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative overflow-hidden bg-black'. Macro block grid: 16x9 divs with 'absolute' positioning. Outgoing video with progressive quality degradation using transform: scale() from 1 to 0.25 then back to 1 with pixelated rendering. Incoming video starts at video1.duration - 0.9s. Macro blocks: random freeze times using animation-play-state, hue-rotate(random 0-360deg), opacity between 0.5-1. Interlacing: even rows with opacity: 0.7, odd rows opacity: 1. Add image-rendering: pixelated to enhance blockiness. Color banding: use posterize filter effect via CSS.

prompts.prompt: Build a quantum glitch transition where videos shift through dimensional rifts with reality-warping effects. The transition should create geometric fragments that rotate in 3D space while shifting between videos. Use BaseLayout with triangular mesh fragments (created using clip-path) that independently rotate and shift during transition. The outgoing VideoAtom breaks apart into geometric shards that spin and fade, while incoming video assembles from similar fragments. During 1.1s overlap, implement 3D rotations using transform: rotate3d() with different axis values per fragment. Add particle effects using small divs that emanate from fragment edges.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative overflow-hidden bg-purple-950 perspective-1000'. Create 20-30 triangle fragments using divs with clip-path: polygon(). Outgoing video fragments with transform: rotate3d(1,1,0, 180deg) translateZ(-100px) opacity: 0. Incoming video starts at video1.duration - 1.1s with inverse animations. Each fragment has random animation-delay between 0-0.8s. Particle divs: 'absolute w-1 h-1 bg-cyan-400' with trajectories using translateX/Y and scale animations. Add backdrop-filter: blur(5px) to fragments. Glow effect: box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,255,255,0.5).

prompts.prompt: Create a signal scramble transition that simulates encrypted video decryption between clips. The effect should show the outgoing video becoming increasingly scrambled and encrypted before the incoming video decrypts into view. Implement using BaseLayout with sliding puzzle-piece segments that rearrange during transition. The video is divided into rectangular segments that slide to wrong positions (scramble) then slide into correct positions (unscramble). During 1.4s overlap, segments should have cascading animation delays creating a wave-like scrambling effect. Add digital noise and encryption artifacts using pseudo-random color shifts and binary code overlays.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative overflow-hidden bg-black'. Create 5x4 grid of video segments using divs with 'absolute overflow-hidden' containing positioned VideoAtom clones. Outgoing segments: animate transform: translate() to random positions outside normal grid. Incoming video starts at video1.duration - 1.4s with segments sliding from random positions to correct grid positions. Use cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55) for elastic easing. Each segment has animation-delay: calc(row * 0.1s + col * 0.05s). Add ::before overlay with rgba(0,255,0,0.1) and binary text. Filter effects: contrast(150%) brightness(90%) hue-rotate(random).
